Architectural laws Setout · V1.0
  • One 24px grid. The ground is a drawing sheet; every section reads off the same 24px measure.
  • One 1px rule. chalk on hivis is 2.66:1, so orange never carries type.
  • Zero radius. A blueprint has no soft corners, no lifted card and no shadow at rest.
  • 160ms linear. The site checks a value; it does not perform an entrance animation.
